name: PostgreSQL
subtitle: Object-relational database (SQL)
creator: Michael Stonebraker's POSTGRES project at UC Berkeley (1986)
description: A standards-compliant relational database with ACID transactions, rich SQL, JSONB for document-style data, full-text search and a powerful extension system including PostGIS and pgvector. It is the most used and most admired database among developers.

languages.youWrite: SQL and PL/pgSQL, usually through an ORM

concepts.explanation: Primary, foreign and unique rules keep data valid.
B-tree, GIN and GiST speed up queries.
Add features like PostGIS or pgvector.

codeSamples.label: SQL
codeSamples.code:
CREATE TABLE users (
  id          uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuidv7(),   -- new in PostgreSQL 18
  email       text UNIQUE NOT NULL,
  profile     jsonb,
  created_at  timestamptz DEFAULT now()
);

SELECT email, profile->>'name' AS name
FROM users
WHERE created_at > now() - interval '7 days'
ORDER BY created_at DESC
LIMIT 10;

pros: Vendor-neutral and available on every host
cons: Needs tuning: vacuum and connection limits
Serverless apps need a connection pooler

pricing.summary: Free and open source. Managed options (Neon, Supabase, RDS and others) are usage-based.
